title: ulmus americana var. rubra
intro: Ulmus americana var. rubra, commonly known as the Red Elm, is a variety of the American Elm tree native to North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Elm include soothing and calming effects on the digestive system, as well as reducing fever and pain. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as the primary active compounds in the plant.
